articleTitle: Research on Bank Credit Risk Assessment Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Credit risk prediction is to forecast whether the borrower can fulfill the financial commitment in advance by taking the relevant information of the customer as the judgment basis. Banks still use traditional mathematical and statistical methods to forecast risks, which cannot meet the growing demand for credit risk forecast business, nor guarantee the quality of forecast. Therefore, this paper studies the application of deep neural network in bank credit risk. This paper presents a bank credit risk forecasting and management model based on multi-level deep neural network. By studying the relationship between each variable and the result of risk prediction, the model further summarizes some features with large impact factors by using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP), and inputs them into the deep neural network, so as to obtain the model’s credit score for customers. The practical application of the system in a commercial bank shows that the system can further improve the accuracy of bank credit risk prediction, improve the management efficiency, reduce the cost of bank credit management, and enhance the competitiveness of the bank.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Art Image Synthesis Algorithm Based on Generation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: As an important artistic creation form and national heritage, painting shows the features of human culture and conveys human thoughts and feelings through beautiful forms of expression, which is a unique form of human understanding of the world. Image generation algorithm is actually the transformation from one image to another, and image synthesis is an important research direction in the field of computer vision. In this paper, the AI (artificial intelligence) art image synthesis algorithm based on generation model is studied. By studying the development of GAN (Generative Adversary Networks), this paper proposes an AI art image synthesis algorithm based on GAN. An hourglass-shaped CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) with layer hopping connection is designed, which consists of coding and decoding. By adding corresponding interval convolution layers, the underlying texture information of the image is preserved, and the identity loss is maintained, so that the original image and the generated image are consistent in color. The results show that all three CNN models have high recognition accuracy for data sets, and the recognition accuracy for both data sets is higher than 99%. The algorithm in this paper is superior to other comparison algorithms in RMSE and PSNR. Experimental results show that this method improves the quality of generated images.

articleTitle: Construction of Traffic Moving Object Detection System Based on Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The detection and recognition technology of moving target is the core technology of video analysis and processing steps in intelligent transportation system, and it is also the premise of technical research on moving target recognition, understanding and behavior analysis in the later stage. In the intelligent transportation system, only by obtaining the parameters such as traffic flow, speed, traffic density, etc., can the traffic automatically maintain the best running state through the adjustment and control of these parameters. In this paper, the construction of traffic moving target detection system based on improved YOLOv5 algorithm is studied. In this paper, the traffic moving target detection scheme firstly inputs the picture data, uses the improved YOLOv5 detection algorithm, and gets the trained detection model by training the vehicle training model. Then, the apparent features are introduced on the basis of DeepSort, which can better deal with the occlusion problem. The tracking performance of the algorithm on pedestrian tracking data set is improved by improving the detector. The research results show that the performance of this algorithm is better than that of YOLOv5 and YOLOv3 before improvement, and its mAP reaches 97.696%. This shows that the improvement of this research is effective, and the improved YOLOv5 target detection algorithm has certain application value in complex real scenes.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology Based on Fast Filtering Algorithm in Switching Operation of Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: At present, VR(Virtual Reality) technology is widely used in various fields, and its effective integration with power system can realize the application of the combination of 3D model roaming and real simulator patrol with the help of VR technology on the basis of 3D refined modeling of substation. In this paper, the application of VR technology based on fast filtering algorithm in substation switching operation is studied. The sequence control program of switching operation of virtual simulation system is established. Generally, the noise in an image is randomly distributed, and its structural features are not obvious, so it can’t be best represented by atoms in a dictionary. In this paper, a denoising algorithm of image frequency division is proposed in combination with fast filtering algorithm. By repeatedly using the fast filtering algorithm, the original fuzzy infrared monitoring image of substation switching operation is divided into spatial domain low-frequency image and spatial domain high-frequency image, which are denoised by different methods respectively, and the denoised images are fused. The results show that the PSNR value of the image frequency division denoising algorithm based on fast filtering proposed in this paper is obviously higher than that of other algorithms. RMSE value is obviously smaller than other algorithms. It can be seen that this algorithm is helpful to effectively denoise the infrared monitoring image of substation switching operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Video Player Tracking Algorithm in Basketball Game Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the number of videos, how to efficiently retrieve the required video information has become an urgent problem, and video annotation is the basis of video indexing and video search. Target tracking technology is of great significance in basketball game video, which is the basis of high-level semantic tasks such as video summary generation, player movement analysis, game strategy formulation and basketball event detection. Intelligent video monitoring system mainly refers to the automatic detection, segmentation, tracking, classification and higher level behavior analysis of objects in the monitoring scene without human intervention, so as to achieve the goal of “real-time monitoring and timely response.” In this paper, a real-time player segmentation and tracking algorithm is implemented to solve the problem of player team membership and tracking in basketball video. Compared with support vector machine algorithm, the two algorithms proposed in this paper have better robustness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Fast Detection Algorithm of Tunnel Surface Cracks Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Cracks are one of the important factors that affect the internal safety of tunnels, and may further deform with the passage of time, which finally has a serious impact on the safety of subway operation, so it is necessary to closely monitor specific dangerous cracks. As a distinguishing structural algorithm, the deep convolution network has excellent performance in image classification and recognition, which is suitable for large sample image processing and can be used for the detection and recognition of complex crack images in subway tunnels. In this paper, a fast detection algorithm of tunnel surface cracks is proposed. The algorithm constructs a tunnel surface crack identification model through convolutional neural network, and removes isolated points and morphologically processes the segmented image to reduce impurity areas in the image. Verified by the data collected in practical engineering, this method has a good effect on crack identification. This detection method can quickly obtain the crack data, which is conducive to the objective evaluation of the structural safety of the tunnel and avoids the interference caused by personal factors of technicians.

articleTitle: A Method of Manipulator Trajectory Control Based on Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper will take the six degrees of freedom robot as the research object, and realize the three-dimensional motion simulation of the six degrees of freedom robot based on software. Basic analysis and modeling of kinematics of six degrees of freedom robot. The first is to analyze the basis of kinematics of the robot, determine the D-H parameters of the six degrees of freedom robot, and establish the six degrees of freedom robot model with the ‘modified’ D-H method. According to the size parameters of the six degrees of freedom robot, the forward and inverse kinematics formulas are derived, and a closed solution method of inverse kinematics with less computational complexity is obtained. Call the robot toolbox in MATLAB to simulate and verify the six degrees of freedom robot, and adjust the position of each joint of the robot to prove the correctness of robot kinematics derivation. This paper mainly adopts Cartesian space trajectory planning. Linear interpolation or circular interpolation is used to determine the starting point and ending point trajectories of the end effector of a six degrees of freedom robot, and then several points are interpolated on the trajectory to determine the coordinates of different intermediate points on the path. Finally, the coordinates of the robot’s intermediate point are calculated in inverse kinematics, and the variables of six joint angles are calculated. Finally, the feasibility of Cartesian space trajectory planning is verified by simulation demonstration in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Research on a Mathematical Modeling Algorithm Based on OLS-STEAM Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper aims to propose a mathematical modeling research based on the OLS-STEAM coupling algorithm, in which STEAM contains five factors to construct the coupling algorithm based on OLS, and uses case data for empirical deduction. The results show that: (1) the algorithm constructed in this paper can effectively solve the related problems in the mathematical modeling algorithm (2) the OLS-STEAM proposed in this paper has good accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Image Processing of Agricultural Product Packaging Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the stage of product development, excellent packaging design is an important link. The status of agricultural product packaging is getting higher and higher in agricultural product trading. Many merchants, including some producers and sellers of agricultural products, are trying their best to make their product packaging look more beautiful and more competitive among similar products. Image recognition technology, that is, using image acquisition device instead of human eye function, using image processing technology to get relevant information and carry out the next operation, has been applied to the inspection stage of agricultural product packaging defects. In this article, an image processing technology of agricultural product packaging based on intelligent optimization algorithm is proposed. According to its own extraction algorithm, image preprocessing, feature extraction and image classification are completed, and then the defect detection of agricultural product packaging and printing is realized. Then the detection accuracy of the two algorithms is compared and analyzed by simulation experiments. The results show that the improved intelligent optimization algorithm can improve the accuracy of defect detection of agricultural products packaging and printing, and realize nondestructive detection.

articleTitle: Research on Coastline Detection Method of SAR Image Based on Seed Point Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In recent years, more and more SAR image technology has been used in the field of sea area management. Among them, the extraction of coastline is one of the hot research issues. During the propagation of electromagnetic waves, due to the inhomogeneity, discontinuity, anisotropy and loss of the medium. Satellite remote sensing technology has the following advantages. First of all, compared with traditional manual operations, satellite remote sensing has the ability of fast collection and wide search range, and can simultaneously observe multiple areas in a relatively short period of time, effectively grasping the instantaneous status of ground or space targets. Although not affected by light intensity, SAR images suffer from inherent speckle noise. Different land geological structures and ground features have complex scattering characteristics. On the ocean, sea wind, whirlpools, tides, etc. will also change the reflection of radar waves. Therefore, it is necessary to use tools such as computers to accelerate the processing of data through automatic identification technology and target feature extraction technology. SAR image processing is such a technology that meets the requirements of large-scale data processing. On land, the radio wave scattering characteristics of different regions will be different, resulting in rich gray levels of land targets. Because the sea area obtained by the algorithm based on seed point growth is connected, it can effectively avoid the interference of noise spots in SAR image, so as to make the detection more stable and robust. On the ocean, due to the factors such as internal wave, vortex and ocean current caused by sea wind, the sea surface presents varying degrees of roughness, resulting in large differences in reflection coefficients. In this way, if a simple method is used to detect the coastline, it is bound to cause great difficulties. Aiming at the idea of seed point growth, this paper presents a fast coastline detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Processing of Ecological Environment Monitoring Based on Multi-scale Retinex Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In recent years, people have paid more attention to the protection of ecological environment, and remote sensing technology has been gradually applied in the process of environmental monitoring. In this article, remote sensing image enhancement based on multi-scale Retinex algorithm is proposed to provide theoretical and technical support for remote sensing image processing of ecological environment monitoring. The wavelet transform method and multi-scale Retinex algorithm are used to enhance remote sensing images. The experimental results show that multi-scale Retinex algorithm has advantages in remote sensing image enhancement and can achieve satisfactory enhancement results. Environmental protection agencies should be deeply aware of the importance of monitoring technology, and can introduce remote sensing technology, Internet of Things technology and automatic monitoring system into environmental monitoring work to promote the continuous improvement of environmental protection work and gradually improve environmental quality.

articleTitle: Simulation of Computer Image Processing Model Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In essence, image recognition, as a pattern classification problem, can also be processed by classical pattern classification algorithms. Under the background of network information technology, it is need to use computer vision algorithm to process the image and realize the three-dimensional reconstruction of the image for the distortion of the true three-dimensional display image of intelligent interactive system. Random Forest (RF) is a new ensemble learning algorithm developed in recent years, which has good classification accuracy. In this article, a computer image processing model based on RF algorithm is proposed to enhance the ability of depth feature learning. The experimental results show that this image processing technology is more accurate than BP neural network and can be widely used in image processing. High-level target feature representation can often improve the recognition accuracy. However, the extraction of high-level target features generally has certain computational complexity. Compared with traditional methods, the accuracy of the proposed method is greatly improved, and the generalization performance is superior, which can identify images that have been beautified and repaired.

articleTitle: Architecture of Intelligent Interactive System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Networking and are the future development directions of interactive service systems. Internet popularization and rich social channels have realistic needs for intelligent interactive services. High-quality and low-cost intelligent interactive solutions have become the main issues that need to be addressed in various industries. Relying on artificial intelligence technology, intelligent means such as intent recognition, semantic understanding, dialogue and judgment were introduced, the integration of scene design and knowledge fragmentation processing technology has brought new means and opportunities for the realization of interactive service intelligence. The problems faced by the existing interactive system were analyzed. On this basis, the key functional elements and system architecture of the intelligent interactive system were designed.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Motion Trajectory Control of Industrial Robot Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Industrial robot system is a very complex multi-input multi-output nonlinear system, which has time-varying, strong coupling and nonlinear dynamic characteristics. In order to further improve the tracking accuracy of the robot and obtain the robot’s speed information in real time, considering the cost of the speed sensor, a finite-time stable output feedback control method is proposed. A nonlinear high-gain observer is used to estimate the robot’s speed information online, so as to realize the robot’s high-precision tracking control. In this paper, the convolution neural network (CNN) in deep learning (DL) is used to process the control parameter data, and high-quality data information is obtained. As input, a motion controller is designed, and the motion trajectory control of industrial robot is realized by combining software and hardware. The advantages of this model are verified by simulation experiments. The results show that, compared with the ant colony algorithm (ACA), the improved CNN has obvious advantages in the later stage of operation, and the error is reduced by 30.69%. Compared with traditional control methods, under the same experimental conditions, the automatic control method of industrial robot based on DL designed has less depth error and higher control accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Human-Computer Interaction System Based on Human Body Attitude Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Aiming at a series of problems in the application of visual human-computer interaction, such as complicated recognition process and low interaction efficiency, a gesture recognition algorithm based on human body structure is proposed. Using this algorithm and the design idea of hardware and software cooperation, a robot control system based on visual perception is implemented on FPGA platform. The attitude sensor is used to obtain the human attitude information and solve it. The attitude is determined by the information fusion method based on D-S evidence theory. combine the complex actions, simplify the operation, obtain the attitude of the remote robot through the “double virtual model” and correct the motion trajectory. Aiming at the defect of single sensor in information detection dimension and the sensitivity to noise data, a multi-sensor fusion method for human posture estimation is proposed. In this paper, an algorithm of human posture recognition (i.e. human joint position recognition) based on model constraints is proposed to solve the problem that the robot system can accurately extract the spatial coordinates of human joints before the transfer and multiplication operation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Design of RBF Neural Network Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: ANN (Artificial Neural Network) is widely used in application fields, but it is a global network structure model, so global information needs to be used in modeling. RBFNN (RBF Neural Network) not only has the bionic background like ANN, but also has the ability to approximate any nonlinear function. In the practical application of RBFNN, people always expect it to have fast global convergence, large-scale mapping generalization ability and less implementation overhead. In this paper, a neural network parameter optimization method based on ACA (Ant Colony Algorithm) and steepest descent method is proposed. A bionic optimization algorithm of RBFNN center parameters is proposed. The simulation results show that both the basic RBF neural network and the basic RBF neural network. It is also the mapping ability of RBF neural network improved in this paper. Compared with the basic RBFNN, the generalization ability is better, and the improved RBF neural network in this paper greatly saves training time and improves the accuracy of the algorithm compared with the first two algorithms.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Particle Motion Based on SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The method of estimating parameters of mechanism model based on SVM and particle swarm optimization (PSO) uses regression of SVM to extract characteristic samples. These few characteristic samples can reduce the calculation time and avoid the blindness of manual random trial and error in selecting training samples. Using PSO to estimate parameters of nonlinear mechanism model can avoid the dependence of traditional methods on initial points and samples. These few feature samples can reduce the calculation time and avoid the blindness of manual random trial and error in selecting training samples. Using PSO to estimate the parameters of nonlinear mechanism model can avoid the dependence of traditional methods on initial points and samples. Industrial examples show that the method proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Landscape Image Processing Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to create a good landscape environment, it is necessary not only to make the layout beautiful and exquisite, in line with the public aesthetic point of view, but also to flexibly use new construction technologies to ensure the good quality of landscape construction, so as to truly create a landscape area with beautiful environment, excellent quality and rich functions for people and provide assistance for the construction and development of the city. The reasonable distribution of high-quality garden landscape can not only represent the overall image of the city, but also represent the cultural heritage of the city. In this paper, an algorithm of landscape image processing based on artificial neural network (ANN) is proposed, and ANN is applied to solve the optimization problem of landscape spatial layout with performance constraints, which realizes the optimization design of landscape spatial layout and lays a solid foundation for the automatic computer optimization design of landscape space. The simulation results show that this algorithm is more accurate in optimizing the spatial pattern of community culture, which is 26.88% higher than the traditional layout optimization algorithm, and can accurately locate the edge contour of the optimized space. This method not only improves the rationality and coordination of landscape planning, but also greatly reduces the cost of community greening planning.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Vision Target Detection Algorithm Based on Deep Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Computer vision (CV) is to use computers to analyze and process the surrounding environment through images or videos, and to simulate the information processing process of human visual system. Computers often need to detect and locate foreground objects in images or videos first, so as to carry out a series of higher-level processing such as subsequent recognition, tracking and analysis. Its core mainly includes two parts: one is the detection and extraction of moving objects; The second is the tracking of moving targets. The detection and extraction of moving target is the premise of target tracking task. If the extracted target is incorrect or incomplete, it will have a great impact on the target tracking part, and even it cannot be tracked effectively. As a technical subject, CV tries to apply its theory and model to construct a CV system. Based on this, this paper takes the depth image as the research object and combines the neural network model in machine learning theory to realize the image occlusion boundary detection task. At the same time, according to the distribution of the feature vectors of pixel points, a nonlinear normalization method is designed to map the feature vectors and train and detect them according to the BP neural network model. All pixel points in the image are divided into occluded boundary points and non-occluded boundary points to achieve the purpose of detection.

articleTitle: Application of Image Acquisition and Processing System Based on Wavelet Transform in Mechanical Product Modeling Design
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In today’s highly competitive market, the product life cycle is shortened, and the product development strategy has changed from product-driven to market-driven. Therefore, enterprises seek to develop new products and pay more and more attention to product style. The modeling design of mechanical products mainly emphasizes meeting the needs of people and society, making beautiful, elegant and exquisite products serve people’s life and production activities, and improving the level of material civilization and spiritual civilization of the whole society. In this paper, an image acquisition and processing model based on wavelet transform (WT) algorithm is proposed to define the modeling parameters of mechanical products and automatically generate new product modeling. The simulation results show that this algorithm is more accurate for feature recognition of mechanical product modeling image, which is 25.77% higher than the traditional algorithm, and can locate the edge contour of mechanical product modeling image more accurately. The image data after WT can keep the fine structure of the original image at various resolutions, which provides convenience for further removing other forms of redundant information in the image. This method provides an automatic design system that enables designers to quickly obtain product modeling and its corresponding images or find the image requirements in a short time of ideal modeling.

articleTitle: Luminaire Sensitivity Adjustment Design Based on Improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm (IAFSA)
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In view of the problems of light intensity delay and inaccurate light intensity in the traditional indoor lighting system, through the comparative analysis of the light intensity and light intensity of indoor lighting, the research is based on the optimization of light intensity to realize the adaptive adjustment of light intensity of lamps, so as to achieve the desired effect of lamps quickly and accurately under the adjustment of light intensity changes. On this basis, this paper introduced a method based on the improved artificial fish swarm algorithm (IAFSA), which made the initial value of the controlled object change in different error intervals with the change of light intensity. On this basis, based on the analysis of simulation experiments, the more accurate regulation of the light sensitivity brightness of the lamps can be realized, and then the effective regulation of the lighting intensity can be realized. The optimized lighting intensity and the unoptimized intensity increased by 7% compared with the average value. The test showed that the control method proposed in this paper had a good improvement in timeliness, brightness and other aspects, and it was suitable for large-scale occasions with high demand for lighting equipment.

articleTitle: Construction of Sports Training Evaluation System Based on Virtual Reality and Motion Capture
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the development of social economy and the improvement of living standard, people begin to seek more realistic simulation experience. As a new multi-channel information fusion technology, virtual reality (VR) is bringing people a brand-new human-computer interaction experience. The existing motion posture capture system needs to wear additional auxiliary equipment for the experimenter, which is inconvenient to operate; And some equipment can’t be applied to outdoor scenes, so the scope of use is limited; The method based on monocular estimation of human body’s three-dimensional posture has low accuracy and poor robustness. Virtual motion based on motion capture verifies the isomorphic motion between life ontology and virtual life, which provides unprecedented possibility for exploring and expressing the essence of life. This paper introduces VR technology and motion capture technology into the protection field of kungfu culture, develops a virtual system that gives consideration to both appreciation and learning, and solves the problem of protection and inheritance. The appreciation system tracks and identifies the user’s body through motion capture technology, uses VR engine to realize motion data driven character model, and realizes the visualization of characters in virtual environment and quantitative evaluation of results.

articleTitle: Application of Object Detection in Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Vehicular technology has been rising rapidly in recent years, to obtain a safe and reliable transportation experience, autonomous vehicles gain more and more advanced equipment to be prepared for the future, which made the foundation of the widespread introduction of Autonomous Vehicles. It leads to many ways to use accurate positioning systems and intelligent environment perception technology, and comprehensive algorithms to deal with various driving situations. Sometimes autonomous vehicles need to be able to tackle tricky choices, the complex expectation of pedestrian behaviors, path organizing, and road sign recognition. For these requirements, Avs need specific targeting data set to train and validate before they can do so. This paper attempts to convey ideas of recent Artificial Intelligence-based techniques in significant functions of Autonomous Vehicles. Finally, this survey outlines the challenges and introduces possible future research directions.

articleTitle: Defogging of Monitoring Images of Soil and Water Conservation of Consumer UAV Based on Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) telemetry technology is a kind of remote sensing and photogrammetry system, which takes UAV as the flight platform and uses the onboard imaging equipment to obtain information such as remote sensing images or videos. It is very suitable for real-time acquisition of high-resolution remote sensing data in a small area. Because the monitoring work is complicated and the environment is diverse, and the survey and statistical data lags behind the change of soil erosion seriously, it is difficult to get accurate information in time for soil and water conservation monitoring, which adds great difficulty to soil and water conservation work. In this article, an image defogging algorithm based on image enhancement is proposed for consumer UAV soil and water conservation monitoring image. From the perspective of image processing, the restored image is finally obtained by performing white balance processing and contrast enhancement processing on the image respectively, based on image fusion and automatic color gradation processing. The speed optimization experiment is carried out by computer coding, and the images before and after defogging are quantitatively compared by objective image quality evaluation method. Experimental results show that compared with wavelet transform algorithm, this algorithm has better processing effect in image detail restoration and color fidelity.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization of Building Information Model Based on Parametric Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The popularity of the Internet has overcome the space and time barriers, improved the speed and scale of information dissemination, and realized the global information exchange and sharing. In China’s construction industry, it has become an industry trend to use BIM technology for related design, construction and management, which has brought about a technological revolution in the civil engineering industry. In order to promote the informatization process of the construction industry and sustainable architectural design, and improve the competitiveness of China’s construction industry, the building information model (BIM) based on parameterized intelligent model technology is studied. Building information model is to use computer-aided technology to bring all stages of the construction industry into the scope of information management. This paper discusses the visualization method of building information model based on parameterized intelligent technology. Combined with the difficulties encountered by Architectural University in recent years in integrating BIM technology into the professional curriculum reform of architectural universities, this paper gives the solutions to the difficulties.

articleTitle: Construction of Urban Planning Model Based on Remote Sensing Image Data Processing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Because of its high spatial resolution, high-resolution remote sensing (RS) images can obtain more detailed information of ground objects, thus improving the accuracy of classification of ground objects. Most of the existing remote sensing processing software adopts the traditional pixel-based classification method, but with the application of more and more high-resolution remote sensing satellites in recent years, the traditional methods can no longer meet the application requirements of high-spatial resolution RS images. In urban planning, it is required that not only the fused RS images have good visual and target classification effects, but also the corrected images have high accuracy. In this paper, a RS image data processing algorithm based on data fusion is proposed. With the help of image fusion technology, image interpretation technology and spatial analysis technology, the change information in the implementation of urban planning is extracted, thus providing technical support for the construction of urban planning model. The experimental results show that with the increase of the number of experiments, the accuracy of this algorithm is stable above 90%, and the real-time wavelength tends to be stable. This scheme is effective in extracting regular buildings from high-resolution RS images.

articleTitle: Billiards Detection and Tracking Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Under the current trend of automation development, in view of the fact that billiards requires a special person to fetch the ball, the tedious labor of putting the ball has also been improved. In order to reduce people’s labor and improve the utilization rate of the billiard table, a fully automatic ball fetching and putting system has been invented. Therefore, this paper makes a further research on billiards detection and tracking technology based on AI (artificial intelligence) algorithm, which can use the local features of the target to track the target, even if the target is partially blocked. The experimental results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of this method. Experiments prove that the billiards tracking accuracy of this AI algorithm is generally higher than that of machine learning algorithm. The highest accuracy of this algorithm can reach 65%, and the highest accuracy of machine learning algorithm is only 37%, which further shows that this algorithm is better than machine learning algorithm. In the tracking of billiards by AI algorithm, by detecting the position information and geometric information of the billiards target in each frame of images, the characteristics of the same billiards in two adjacent frames of images can be matched.

articleTitle: Design of Path Planning Algorithm for Tourist Attractions Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: There is no reasonable tourism planning route, the number of individual tourist attractions is too large, resulting in a low tourist safety factor, and the number of tourists in a few scenic spots is scarce, which has become the biggest problem that plagues tourism companies and tourists. DL (Deep learning) based on ANN (artificial neural network), a DL structure is constructed by using multi-layer perceptron with multiple hidden layers. In this paper, the path planning algorithm of tourist attractions based on DL is designed. Aiming at the defects of BPNN (BP neural network) such as slow convergence speed and easy to fall into local minimum points, the ACO (ant colony optimization) with good global search ability is proposed. The global update formula is further optimized in the strategy based on the combination of global and local update pheromones in the improved scheme, and this global and local update pheromone scheme is applied to BPNN. The research results show that the algorithm in this paper is more effective and the optimization efficiency is higher, and the ACO-optimized BPNN not only greatly saves the complexity of operation but also improves the efficiency, and efficiently obtains the specific route of each path, providing convenient services for travel enthusiasts.

articleTitle: Application Research of Quantum Cryptography Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Quantum cryptography communication technology is based on information security and it can achieve unconditional security, having been applied in many fields. Therefore, the author carries out study of the applications of the quantum cryptography communication technology. The author firstly outlines the principle of the technology, analyzes the network architecture of the technology and discusses the implementation of Quantum Key Distribution (QKD). Secondly, the author expounds the existing application scenarios and application methods, and finally prospects the future research development and the problems in engineering applications to be solved.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Visual Tracking Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Visual tracking is a challenge in computer vision. Visual tracking has various practical application scenarios, and is used in intelligent video surveillance system, analysis and research of driver’s abnormal behavior, intelligent robot research and other fields. Visual tracking algorithm combines video processing, automatic system control, informatics and so on, so as to automatically identify the target from the video image and extract the tracked target position information. In this paper, the visual tracking algorithm is designed and optimized based on deep learning. The experimental data show that the algorithm used in this paper is more advantageous, and the experimental results are evaluated by accuracy and success rate. The figure shows the percentage of the tracked target in the tracking frame. The error between the center position of the tracked target and the real target is measured by different thresholds. Similarly, the success rate indicates the percentage of the successfully tracked target frame, and the proposed algorithm is superior to the traditional tracking algorithm, so it is feasible to optimize the visual tracking algorithm. The target detection algorithm based on deep learning can achieve better target detection effect, and the amount of calculation is small. Continuous real-time tracking can effectively solve the problem of target blocking and improve the accuracy of visual tracking.

articleTitle: Application of Genetic Algorithm in the Design of Safety Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the continuous development of emerging information technology and global computer digital technology, in order to ensure the safety of civil engineering safety structure, the research on genetic algorithm has been applied to the design of civil engineering safety monitoring system, and it is necessary to apply safety monitoring technology to monitor and evaluate the performance of the structure in real time. Due to the increasing demand for construction safety management of a series of complex large-scale projects in China, the uncertainties in safety management and monitoring control have increased, resulting in prominent construction management problems, and the cost and benefit of construction management are in uncontrollable risks. This paper will analyze the theoretical model and coding mode of the algorithm from the perspective of genetic algorithm, and then analyze the practical application of genetic algorithm in the design project of civil engineering safety monitoring system, summarize the existing problems of monitoring technology and the future research direction, improve the reliability of construction safety management, improve the safety environment and construction management efficiency of civil engineering construction, and hope that genetic algorithm can be further applied and popularized in the future development of civil engineering.

articleTitle: Nondestructive Testing Method of Engineering Material Defects Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The Nondestructive Testing (NDT) technology of engineering materials is closely related to Artificial Intelligence (AI), computer and other disciplines. AI algorithm is a new machine learning method based on the existing computer. The inspection of engineering materials is a very important work. In order to ensure the safety of the project, the materials must be inspected in advance during the construction of the project. In this paper, the methods of algorithm comparison and experimental simulation were mainly used to carry out relevant experiments on the NDT of engineering material defects under the AI algorithm. The data results showed that under the feedforward neural network, the maximum error between the experimental results and the simulation results was 1.7% after the weighted average calculation. The absolute error value was small and could play a better role in NDT.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Distribution System of Tour Group Routes under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In this paper, several algorithms are introduced to scientifically customize and design tourist spots and tourist routes, and a new algorithm for screening and combining tourist spots by using a large group is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is suitable for large-scale problems, and can provide a reference for the tourism and scientific research departments to formulate macro strategies, and it is also feasible to establish a domestic tourism query system.

articleTitle: Application of Gesture Recognition Technology Based on Deep Learning in Intelligent Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Gesture recognition technology has great value in real life applications, and it is still not mature and has many difficulties to overcome. Therefore, gesture recognition technology still has high research value. The core of this paper is to design a feasible intelligent laboratory, and improve the image segmentation and gesture tracking algorithms to improve the accuracy of gesture recognition. SSD network replaces all the connected layers of the front-end basic network with convolution layers, and extracts the result of one convolution layer for target detection. In this paper, the common convolution layer is split, and each convolution group is divided into a set of deep convolution and a set of point convolution, and each layer has its own convolution kernel by deep convolution operation. The results show that the test accuracy of the proposed algorithm is 97.406%, and it shows better classification and recognition ability when running on the self-built database. DL (Deep learning) will automatically learn the characteristics of gestures in the training set, and when the whole task is implemented end-to-end, regression model will be used to solve the detection task, and the detection result will be significantly improved. Can realize certain market application.

articleTitle: Research on Public Management Statistical Data Quality Management Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Public statistical data is a general term for data and analysis reflecting economic and social phenomena collected, collated and used by government statistical departments through various statistical work. Management of public statistical data quality management is an indispensable part of the government’s public management. It is a general term for activities to ensure the quality of government statistical data and supervise and control according to law. Its contents mainly include the scheme design of statistical work, the collection and summary accounting of statistical data, the statistical analysis of integrated data, the release and supervision of final statistical information, control and modification, etc. In this paper, the fuzzy clustering algorithm is a tool to find knowledge quickly and effectively. Fuzzy clustering algorithm is a step-by-step iterative data clustering method based on objective function optimization. Therefore, using fuzzy clustering algorithm can improve the speed of information retrieval and the efficiency of information utilization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Neurology Medical Data Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Objective: In this article, we construct such a mechanism. It’s browser-based, so users can access it from anywhere and view their own or a loved one’s pertinent medical data directly from the system website. Method:We used hospital HIS data from the past, daily clinical data collected by doctors, and data from other medical systems.By sorting out the neurology dictionary in advance, we can improve the accuracy of word segmentation and retrain the corpus. Then judge the emotional characteristics of medical records according to the characteristics and screen patients. Results:Based on the existing medical data, the system expands the data analysis functions commonly used by medical staff in actual scenes, provides support for the establishment of high-quality medical data sets in hospital neurology, and makes medical research more effective.Conclusion:The features of this system include exporting medical data, editing existing data, adding new data, retrieving medical data to view statistical analysis results for data items, and more.

articleTitle: Research on Application of 3d Information Model in Oilfield Development
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The No. L Oilfield is an old oil field that has been developed for many years. With the advent of the era of artificial intelligence, the company has carried out the technical transformation, innovation, and upgrading of the No. L Oilfield to meet the change of comprehensive informatization, comprehensively upgraded the engineering design software, eliminated the original two-dimensional design, and fully adopted BIM design. The company relies on the building information model to meet the architectural design tasks in the existing oil region. The BIM model contains much more information than the 2D CAD plane, including complete information such as equipment name, structure type, construction process, cost, human resources, machinery, etc., which makes the architectural design tasks completed through BIM software more information-based and intelligent, so as better to serve the future oilfield industry upgrading and construction. Although the current BIM-related design and software are still new and have many shortcomings, with the development of technology and the continuous improvement of software, the building information model will play a decisive role in the future intelligent information age for oil field construction.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Design of Tunnel Based on Lonberg Algorithm and Intelligent optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The establishment of the spatial alignment model of the left and right tunnel axes is of great importance for the construction and operation of the tunnel. This paper presents a tunnel computer-aided design model based on Lonberg algorithm and intelligent optimization. First, the projection of the central axis of a single tunnel in the plane is assumed to be a straight line, and the central axes of the tunnel and the tunnel are in a plane perpendicular to the plane, so that the problem can be solved in the two-dimensional plane. Second, the projection of the two tunnels’ central axis on the plane, the elevation data on this projection plane are interpolated by three splines, and the interpolation function for each small distance is constructed, and the three-turn angle equation used to solve the coefficients is constructed using the function characteristics, and the three-turn angle equation is solved by Thomas’ algorithm to obtain the interpolation function of the central axis for each small distance. After the specific interpolation function is obtained, the curve integration of the segmentation function is performed using the Lonberg algorithm to obtain the total tunnel length after projection, and then the original tunnel length is calculated by projection inversion. Finally, using the fixed-step search algorithm, the 100-meter calibration is completed.

articleTitle: Design of Students Information Management System Based on Mining Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the expansion of colleges and universities, the number of students is increasing, and the difficulty of student management is increasing. The increasing number of students brings challenges to school management. In order to improve the efficiency and level of student management, many schools have begun to devote themselves to the research and application of student information management system. In the student information management system, in addition to the realization of students’ basic information such as major, school roll, class management, but also the students’ course selection service, learning progress, graduation thesis management, employment information management and other related content into it, to achieve all the students’ information management of the “one-stop” service. Through the special student information management system, all the information of students are integrated together, to achieve a high level of management of all information.

articleTitle: Research on Bridge Condition Monitoring Based on Image Processing Technology and Bridge Crack Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Concrete bridge is one of the most common and widely used types at present, which has the advantages of low construction cost, readily available materials, strong bridge diversity, long service life and firmness. At the same time, concrete itself has some shortcomings such as easy shrinkage, which will make cracks in concrete bridges more common. The outstanding performance of deep learning and digital image processing technology in various fields provides a new idea for the detection and extraction of bridge cracks. In this paper, a bridge crack image recognition algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) is proposed, and the binary image of cracks is analyzed. Through the statistical analysis of eigenvalues and the characteristics of crack targets, cracks are extracted. The simulation results show that the accuracy of bridge crack detection based on GAN is higher, which is 24.78% higher than that of the contrast algorithm, and the recall rate is increased by 19.64%, which can accurately locate the edge contour of bridge crack image. GAN algorithm can define the fracture characteristics independently and carry out learning and training. Compared with artificially defined crack characteristics, GAN technology is not easily influenced by human factors, and has high detection accuracy and strong generalization ability, which is suitable for bridge crack detection tasks in complex environments.

articleTitle: Construction of Virtual Simulation Training Platform for Enterprise Operation Based on Workflow
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the advent of the network information age, people’s study, work and life are inseparable from computers and networks. At present, the virtual simulation training system designed with traditional client/server model can not fully integrate new technologies and give full play to the advantages of new management mode. The development of network technology and virtual simulation technology provides a technical basis for the reform of experimental teaching in colleges and universities. More and more colleges and universities are actively building virtual simulation experimental teaching platforms to solve the problems of lack of traditional experimental resources and limited conditions. The position and role of office automation in all walks of life are becoming more and more important. The army has taken office automation construction as an important part of information construction. Accelerating the construction of office automation in the army is of great significance to the information construction of the whole army. Because the traditional WFMS-based workflow model easily leads to the huge system architecture and increased complexity; Contemporary popular lightweight workflow model is based on the principle of sufficiency, flexibility and low cost, which is more suitable for integration in application systems. The virtual simulation experiment management platform includes five functional modules: portal website, experimental teaching, information management, online Q & A and background management, which can meet the needs of experimental teaching management in our school. Based on the discussion of the current enterprise research and its business process research, this paper introduces the workflow theory and technology into the enterprise business process research, and deeply studies the enterprise operation virtual simulation training platform based on workflow. Compared with the traditional experimental management system, the biggest feature of this paper is to analyze the functional requirements of workflow management system and the efficiency of workflow engine in detail, realize the construction of enterprise operation virtual simulation training platform, and ensure the pertinence of simulation training content.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm Design of 3D Animation Rendering Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, people’s thinking mode has also changed dramatically. 3D animation and virtual reality (VR) technology can be seen everywhere around people. With the development of technology, 3D animation and VR technology are applied in more and more fields, such as education, medical treatment and commerce. Under the background of increasing international competition, the update speed of high-tech is changing with each passing day. With the wide application of VR technology by modern people, the 3D animation industry has been further developed. The effective combination of 3D animation scene graphic design and VR technology can further improve the overall perfection of 3D animation scene design. This paper improves the lighting model and shadow rendering algorithm according to the defects of the general lighting rendering algorithm in the application of 3D animation scenes. Based on this, a hybrid 3D scene lighting rendering algorithm is obtained. When optimizing the Cook Torrance lighting model, a geometric attenuation factor algorithm is used, and when improving the shadow rendering algorithm, a light shadow rendering algorithm based on variance shadow is used.

articleTitle: Research on virtual simulation design system of Han embroidery crafts under computer digital image vision technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the advent of the digital age of computers, the public is keener and keener on the dissemination of network culture, intangible cultural heritage is quietly disappearing from people’s lives, and the living environment of Han embroidery has been hit unprecedentedly. In recent years, the rapid development of computer digital image technology has brought new development opportunities for the protection and dissemination of intangible cultural heritage. In this paper, the virtual simulation design of Han embroidery handicrafts is carried out through computer digital image visual technology, and a virtual simulation system of Han embroidery handicrafts that can be combined with intangible cultural heritage is developed. The method of digital collection transforms the design of Han embroidery handicrafts into digital design and carries out storage, collection, and protection. The development of this system has played an important role in the digital upgrade of the design of Han embroidery handicrafts.

articleTitle: Design of Target Detection Algorithm in Airport Flight Area Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: When the airport is in normal operation all day, the airport flight area bears the important responsibility of taking off and landing. Runway intrusion will disturb the operation order of the airport, but it will seriously affect the safety of all passengers and crew, and the runway safety will be severely tested. In this study, a target detection algorithm in airport flight area based on fuzzy clustering is proposed, and KF (Kalman filtering) is used to predict the area where the moving target may be located at the next moment, so as to narrow the search target area and achieve the goal of fast tracking the moving target. On the basis of FCM (fuzzy c-means) method, the idea of fuzzy clustering is used to suppress noise. According to different membership degrees, the points far from the center of the set can be suppressed. The results show that the correlation filter algorithm combined with scale filter can estimate the scale of moving objects, and the algorithm in this paper is robust when tracking moving objects with varying scales. Tracking multiple moving targets independently at the same time, because KF estimation can get the continuous moving state of moving targets, on the basis of ensuring the detection accuracy, the running speed of the target detection algorithm in this paper has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Information Management System of Foreign Weapons and Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the information age, with the continuous development of high-tech weapons and equipment, more and higher requirements are put forward for their management. The information management of weapons and equipment has brought profound influence and development to the management of weapons and equipment. Its purpose is to provide an all-directional, system-wide and whole-cycle information management mode for military weapons and equipment, so as to improve the management efficiency and reliability of equipment and ensure the full realization of the operational effectiveness of weapons and equipment. This paper analyzes the status quo and successful experience of the military information management of weapons and equipment in some western developed countries, and studies and explains some advanced technologies in the information management of weapons and equipment, which lays a certain foundation for the further improvement of the level of information management of weapons and equipment in China.

articleTitle: Research on Foreground Extraction and Target Detection and Tracking Algorithm of Surveillance Video Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the popularization of intelligent monitoring system, it is more and more important to detect remnants and crowd anomalies. At present, most of the anomaly detection methods of left-behind objects rely on tracking the object carriers, while the anomaly detection methods of crowds mostly judge the anomaly by detecting and tracking the trajectory of pedestrian targets and then analyzing whether their behaviors conform to the normal state. How to efficiently analyze the video data acquired by the video surveillance network by artificial intelligence is a frontier topic in the field of computer vision recently. Moreover, with the rapid development of computer science and technology and video surveillance hardware, the industry has higher and higher requirements for intelligent surveillance technology. Therefore, the quality standard of video target tracking and detection technology based on deep learning directly affects the quality of video target tracking based on deep learning. This paper mainly introduces three common methods of video target tracking and detection based on deep learning, and makes a comparative study of different methods, analyzing their advantages and disadvantages, hoping to provide some help for the further research of video tracking and detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Medical Spectral Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Multispectral medical images contain many kinds of tissues, and the characteristics of tissues in different band images are different. How to extract valuable tissue information from multi-spectral images is the key to the diagnosis aided by image processing technology, and tissue segmentation is an important prerequisite to realize the diagnosis aided. In this article, the algorithm of medical spectral image segmentation based on ANN is improved. According to the characteristics of convolutional neural network (CNN), the method of adding normalization layer between input layer and hidden layer, adding numerical reduction layer after output layer and the method of targeted learning are adopted to strengthen the training of CNN. The medical spectral image segmentation algorithm based on the improved CNN algorithm has more advantages than the traditional SVM algorithm in both accuracy and efficiency. This model mainly introduces multi-scale feature input on the basis of all CNN, and adopts convolution kernels with different sizes for input images of different scales to extract the feature information of the bottom layer and the top layer, and then uses feature fusion method to fuse the extracted multi-scale feature information as the input of the network and the final result output.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Sports Video Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Feature Correlation Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The basic task of sports video target tracking system is to track and detect the given target in detail and describe every action of the target comprehensively and accurately according to the given sports video. Accurate detection of targets in video can not only reduce the time and calculation required for subsequent processing of video, but also carry out various high-level processing of video. In this paper, the optimal design of sports video target tracking algorithm based on feature correlation matching is launched. Firstly, gray correlation matching is used to solve the problem of rigid target tracking under occlusion. Secondly, GCN (Graph Convective Network) is used to integrate adjacent context information, and the geometric distance between target players is used to adaptively adjust the weight of adjacent information. For players with similar appearance, the improved contextual features are obviously more discriminating than the traditional individual features. The research results show that the algorithm in this paper is optimal in both the average accuracy curve and the success rate. As far as the average speed is concerned, this algorithm inherits the speed advantage of correlation filtering tracking while ensuring high performance, and its average speed is 170.699, which is 3.3 times that of Mean Shift algorithm. It shows that the algorithm is more robust and accurate, and from the point of view of algorithm implementation, it is simple and easy to use, and has high real-time characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on rail surface crack identification and detection based on deep learning and image processing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the implementation of the development program of our country’s transportation country, the traffic construction has welcomed a booming development, the passenger transportation and freight transportation increasing year by year, but it brings more and more high requirements on the quality of the steel rail, the steel rail due to the long-term service and all kinds of defects appear, especially with the rolling contact fatigue cracks. A method and system of rail surface crack identification and detection based on deep learning is proposed. The crack features can be accurately extracted from the complex image of rail surface for real-time crack identification and detection. The crack width can be identified as 0.1mm, and the recognition speed can reach 1-2ms. The rapid identification and detection of rail surface cracks are completed.

articleTitle: Research on Image Multi-Feature Steganography Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Digital steganography is one of the important branches of information security. It hides information in common transmission carriers in life, such as digital images, digital video, digital audio signals, etc., hiding the existence of information. At present, digital image steganography has become one of the research hotspots in the field of information security. Steganalysis technology uses the change of information embedding to the statistical characteristics of the original carrier to determine the existence of hidden information, so as to detect whether information is embedded in the carrier. In this paper, based on DL (Deep Learning), the steganographic analysis of image multiple features is further studied. The image multiple features can be divided into gray image, color image and binary image according to the difference of color and value bits represented by them. Grayscale images only express the brightness value of image pixels, but not the color information of image pixels. In view of the particularity of image steganography analysis task, the general DL network is specially designed, and the accuracy and speed of analysis are studied by changing the network structure, network layers, activation function and adding filter layer convolution.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching of Visual Communication Design Based on Automatic Layout Algorithm of Graphic Language
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Because of its innovative design language, visual communication technology has greatly changed the design concept and design method of the media, thus providing a broader development space for visual design. Graphic design is the foundation of visual design. To make visual communication more beautiful, we need to have a clear understanding of graphic design and language. The arrival of digital era is both an opportunity and a challenge for visual design, which puts forward new requirements for visual design and the training of visual design talents. In this paper, an automatic layout algorithm of graphic language is proposed, and the unique information expression of visual design graphic language is studied. The simulation results show that this algorithm is more accurate in automatic recognition of graphic language, which is 28.66% higher than the comparison algorithm, and can accurately locate the edge contour of graphics. The results have practical significance on how to convey information more accurately and efficiently by graphic language of visual design, and can provide strong technical support for the teaching of visual design major in the background of digital era.

articleTitle: Application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Image Denoising Based on FPGA in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Tilt Photography Assisted Intelligent Construction Site Management
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Smart construction site is a smart management platform built by means of Internet, Internet of Things, big data, BIM technology, digital technology and tilt photography technology. Managers can obtain a high-precision, high-resolution real three-dimensional real-life model of the construction site through oblique photography technology. In this paper, the application of UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) tilt photography aerial survey technology combined with FPGA in smart site system effectively integrates various resources in engineering construction, cost control, safety supervision, data analysis and decision efficiency, and realizes the monitoring and management of engineering projects. According to the actual survey data information, before planning the route, the system automatically matches the points with the same name in all the images through dense matching technology, and extracts more feature points from the images to form dense point clouds, thus more accurately expressing the details of the ground objects and effectively utilizing and expressing the underground information around the rail transit line; Finally, it provides basic conditions for spatial analysis such as personnel or large-scale equipment positioning analysis, rationality analysis of underground pipeline relocation and reconstruction, and regional management of key buildings in shield area.

articleTitle: Study on Limit Equilibrium Stability Analysis Method of Rock and Soil Slope Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The equilibrium stability of rock-soil slope has always been the focus of civil industry and specialty, and the establishment of its stability is one of the difficult and hot issues faced by civil engineering. The traditional slope limit analysis methods are mostly based on the basic theory and operation principle of LimiState software to simulate the inclined layered soil slope of common slope projects. Although the results obtained by limit analysis are accurate, they still lack certain applicability. In this paper, the limit equilibrium stability of rock and soil slopes will be analyzed by improving genetic algorithm, and Powell algorithm will be added as a local process on the basis of genetic algorithm, which can ensure the global search ability of genetic algorithm and increase its search speed. The improved genetic algorithm will search the minimum safety factor of rock and soil slopes, which will bring new method analysis for the limit equilibrium stability of rock and soil slopes and provide technical support and theoretical construction for the development of civil engineering.

articleTitle: Basketball Training System Based on 3D Motion Intelligent Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development in the fields of computer vision and deep learning, the combination of computer and camera has been used to replace the human eye to achieve the segmentation, classification and recognition of targets, especially in the detection, tracking and action analysis of motion images. The aim of this paper is to investigate the design and implementation of a basketball-assisted training system based on 3D motion recognition technology. This paper discusses the background and significance of basketball assisted training, provides an in-depth analysis of domestic and international research on shooting and assisted training, proposes a human motion recognition model using graphical neural networks to establish spatio-temporal graphical convolutional neural networks, and designs and develops an assisted system that can help basketball players in sports training. The platform for implementing the system and the technology used are introduced, and the system is verified. The implementation platform and the technology used are presented and the effectiveness of the system is verified.

articleTitle: Research on a Predictive Model Based on Machine Learning DART-XGBOOST Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This article aims to propose a prediction model based on the DART XGBOOST algorithm. Firstly, the DART (with Dropout decision tree) is used for ensemble learning, and finally the XGBOOST algorithm is combined through clustering algorithm. Based on this, MSE and R2 are set as test indicators, and 25 sets of data are used as empirical objects. The results show that: (1) DART XGBOOST has high robustness and generalization performance, Can perform model prediction well (2) When the number of DARTs is 500, the model accuracy converges and reaches the optimal level. This algorithm provides a certain reference for proposing prediction models.

articleTitle: Autonomous Robot Motion Decision Algorithm Based on Decision Tree Algorithm and Deep Learning Technology
