publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Generally, the traditional robot path planning method can solve the modeling problem well, but the common feature is that there is a lack of search ability in the planning process, which often needs to be combined with other search algorithms. Intelligent method can solve the problem of path planning in complex environment, but some problems will be encountered in the application process. In order to change the problems of traditional robots, such as fixed movements and lack of adaptability, Deep learning (DL) has been gradually introduced into intelligent robot technology. Because the amount of data of environmental parameters that make up the robot is not large, it is easy to obtain a simple data classification rule, and the robot can recognize the environment according to this classification rule. In this paper, an autonomous robot motion decision algorithm based on decision tree and DL technology is proposed, which can complete the functions of robot motion, information collection and processing. Through the overall design of the tracking system, the design of data and robot’s bottom-level instruction transformation and the choice of data transmission mode, a test environment is set up to test the target, and the tracking performance of the improved algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Autonomous Role Design of Game Based on Neural Network Algorithm and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: At present, the interaction mode of role behavior in most games is deterministic interaction behavior. Such deterministic behavior often fails to reflect the autonomy of the role, and it also leads to the monotonous action of the role, which is easily predicted by the player and reduces the playability of the game. In this paper, the design of game autonomous role based on neural network algorithm and AI (artificial intelligence) is developed. Based on cognitive role modeling, this paper puts forward the design idea of game autonomous role by combining BPNN (BP neural network) and GA (genetic algorithm). Using GA to optimize BPNN, applying GA in BPNN can realize automatic optimization of learning rules, and improve the learning efficiency and the optimization speed of weight coefficient of BPNN. The research results show that using the optimized neural network algorithm to evolve the autonomous role of the game can reduce the computational complexity by about 25% compared with using the traditional evolutionary neural network algorithm. The running results of virtual characters in the system show the effectiveness of the behavior model; The effectiveness of the optimized neural network algorithm is verified by experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Force Atlas Dynamic Network Algorithm for Intelligent Speech Recognition Based on Machine Computers
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper proposes a Force Atlas dynamic network algorithm based on machine-computer intelligent speech recognition. The algorithm uses the Force Atlas algorithm to construct a speech recognition network and combines machine learning technology to real-time adjust and optimize the network. Specifically, the algorithm connects different speech units into a dynamic speech recognition network through feature extraction and pattern recognition of speech signals. On this basis, the Force Atlas algorithm is used to lay out and adjust the network to achieve fast and accurate recognition of voice signals. Experimental results show that the algorithm has a high recognition rate and robustness, and can be effectively applied to the field of machine computer intelligent speech recognition.

articleTitle: Intelligent Hybrid System of Collective Architectural Design Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Due to its advantages of appropriate scale and high overall cost performance, the collective building occupies a very important position in the housing market, especially in small and medium-sized cities, where multi-storey houses almost dominate the whole country. Based on the analysis and research of the basic knowledge such as expert system, knowledge base, language, etc., an intelligent hybrid system of collective architectural design is established, which is mainly composed of expert system and interface standard of knowledge base. The definition of fitness function of GA (Genetic Algorithm) takes into account the classification accuracy of the constructed fuzzy classification system and the number of fuzzy rules at the same time. On this basis, the rule redundancy caused by data distribution is continuously deleted to obtain the final classification system. The GA set comprehensive optimization model of architectural decision-making design scheme is established, and the effectiveness of this method in architectural decision-making design is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Defect Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5s Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Due to the problems of low detection accuracy and inaccurate positioning in the process of rail surface defect detection, this study introduced YOLOv5s into the SE module (Squeeze-and-Excitation) to increase the small amount of calculation to improve the sensitivity of the YOLOv5s model to the rail surface defect detection channel features, and then effectively improve the defect detection recognition ability and improve the problem of small defects missed detection. In addition, we used the $\alpha$-CIOU loss function instead of the GIOU loss function as the bounding box loss function to improve the accuracy of bounding box localization. The results showed that the proposed model has an average accuracy AP of 92.8%, a detection speed of 32 FPS on GPU for rail surface defect images, and a model memory occupation of 34.8 Mb. In this paper, the improved algorithm based on YOLOv5s can realize fast and accurate identification on the railroad. Compared with the YOLOv5s algorithm for rail surface defect detection, it has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: Research on hybrid attribute big data clustering algorithm based on grid coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Due to the lack of consideration of the interaction between the clustering grids, the data clustering algorithm suffers from poor clustering quality. Therefore, a hybrid attribute big data clustering algorithm based on grid coupling is proposed. By defining the basis of relevant parameters through grid coupling, we obtain the center-of-mass spacing of the grids in the process of grid coupling and use the grids to perform big data clustering and fully analyze the influence of the weights among the grids. The clustering algorithm is carried out in two stages: the online stage updates the grid feature vectors and divides the grid according to the dynamic changes of attributes; the offline stage constructs an undirected graph, with the vertices set as the network centroids, the center-of-mass distance and the centroid spacing as the edges, and obtains the minimum spanning tree and cuts off the r-1 largest edge of the tree, and finally obtains k clusters of the hybrid attribute big data. The algorithm achieves the accurate clustering of hybrid attributes. The experimental results show that the algorithm has a good clustering effect with moderate values of center-of-mass adjustment parameters and center-of-mass distance, and the clustering quality and efficiency are high.

articleTitle: 3D Landscape Rendering and Optimization Algorithm of Digital City Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The urban elements necessary for building a smart city and the existing development potential of the city are unclear, leading to many challenges in the construction of smart cities, and new urban problems have emerged one after another. In order to solve the corresponding problems, this paper discusses the functional characteristics of the three-dimensional landscape in the digital city, analyzes the technical ideas of the construction of the three-dimensional landscape system in the digital city, and discusses some key technologies in the construction of the three-dimensional landscape system. In this paper, when establishing the building electricity consumption forecasting model at the city level, a variety of optimizations are made to overcome the defects of the conventional convolution neural network model: (1) the combination model takes the mean value to overcome randomness; Adding statistical rules to eliminate the influence of individual singular prediction values; Learning in real time to improve the accuracy of long-term prediction increased by 26.32%. From the influencing factors of improving the development potential of smart cities, choosing scientific smart city development mode, improving the capacity of smart city construction and strengthening the safeguard measures of smart city development, this paper puts forward some countermeasures, and provides reference suggestions and decision support for solving the problems of smart city construction and development.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Garden Landscape Space Environment Based on Remote Image Acknowledge
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid progress and improvement of society and economy, the importance of urban modernization has gradually become prominent, and the garden landscape design of urban residential areas is very vital for urban construction. However, in the garden landscape design of urban residential areas, various factors need to be considered, which leads to a significant increase in its complexity. Aiming at the problems of large judgment error and low efficiency in traditional judgment methods, a method for judging the rationality of landscape design based on remote image acknowledge is proposed. However, there are many problems that need to be paid attention to in the garden landscape design of the urban residential area, and the garden landscape design work of the urban residential area is also extremely complicated. Therefore, it is very vital to improve the landscape design of urban residential areas. Based on remote image acknowledge, this paper uses weights to express the rationality of landscape design for remote image acknowledge, which can implement robust acknowledge algorithms and analyze the rationality weights of landscape design for remote image acknowledge. Identify the rationality of landscape design to judge.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Thermal Effect of Urban Subway Spatial Layout Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In recent years, due to urban overexploitation and traffic congestion on the ground, underground railway traffic has become a major mode of public transportation because of its safety and speed. Machine learning algorithm is used to iteratively recover missing data and extract features. Combined with a small amount of temperature measurement data, the temperature distribution is reconstructed in real time. Using computational fluid dynamics, the thermal environment of subway station public area is numerically simulated. Including the simulation of single-train inbound and outbound working conditions and double-train inbound and outbound working conditions, the distribution of velocity field and temperature field in the public area of subway station personnel is determined according to the simulation, and the piston air ventilation rate basically meets the ventilation demand of five air changes per hour after being checked hourly throughout the day. The research in this paper provides theoretical analysis basis and test scheme for the engineering application of controllable tuyere screen door system in subway.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Vision Target Detection Algorithm Based on Feature Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Computer vision has formed many research branches because of its different application fields and uses. Due to the influence of various environmental factors in real life, the clarity, completeness and distinctiveness of such target features are lacking to a certain extent, which brings great challenges to the existing algorithms. In this paper, a computer vision target detection algorithm based on SIFT (Scale Invariant Feature Transform) feature recognition is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm preprocesses the target image and the input image, then detects the existence of some feature points, that is, generates feature vectors, and obtains candidate matching points through the matching of feature vectors. Finally, it judges whether the target is recognized or not according to the number of matching points. The research results show that the target detection algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively combine and filter matching through multiple steps, and the matching accuracy is significantly improved compared with the traditional algorithm. The research results show that the background subtraction method is used to extract the moving target, which ensures the integrity of the detected target and improves the real-time and accuracy of the moving target detection.

articleTitle: Design of Data Information Processing System Based on Genetic Algorithm and BIM
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to solve the current challenges of data collection, analysis and modelling in building construction, a set of data information processing system for building assembly construction based on BIM technology is established by combining BIM technology and genetic algorithm. Based on this, a multi-objective engineering scheduling optimization model with dual objectives of cost and resources is established, and genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimal engineering scheduling time and the start time of each process. Finally, the validity and correctness of the proposed theory and method will be verified by combining with engineering examples, so as to provide scientific and reasonable solutions for engineering construction, promote the application of BIM technology in engineering construction and enhance the benefits of engineering construction.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Modal Yoga Gesture Detection Based on Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Human motion posture detection has very important application value in real life, such as medical diagnosis, sports training and bionic engineering. In order to scientifically evaluate students’ movements and postures in online yoga teaching, the human-computer interaction technology based on in-depth information is integrated into physical education classroom teaching to solve related problems in online yoga teaching. Industry relies more on efficient processes that can produce a variety of products, and the safety and reliability of production and operation have become the focus of engineers’ attention. A multi-modal process monitoring algorithm based on Gaussian mixture model is proposed. Aiming at the problem that offline data has no modal labels, an offline data classification algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the problem that online data can’t correspond to modal types, an online data modal identification algorithm is proposed. It may be the change of product type, the change of process production plan, etc., which leads to the adjustment of steady-state operating point; It may be the inherent characteristic of the process itself, which makes a production process have multiple operation periods; It may also be the change of raw material properties, external environment, process load and other conditions or equipment wear and other factors, which lead to the change of process operating conditions.

articleTitle: Research and Application Based on EEMD and GAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In this paper, the data series are first decomposed using an integrated empirical modal decomposition method. The decomposed series are then reorganized into high-frequency, low-frequency and trend terms using zero-mean hypothesis testing. The reorganized sequences are predicted separately using a generative adversarial network model. The generator of the GAN model consists of long- and short-term memory network layers, a self-attentive mechanism layer and a one-dimensional convolutional layer to generate the predicted data sequences. In this paper, experiments are conducted on the WTI dataset. The experimental results show that the EEMD-GAN model proposed in this paper has better prediction results than the LSTM, ARIMA and WGAN-GP models, and the RMSE of the test set reaches 4.11.

articleTitle: Construction of Image Segmentation and Recognition System Based on Deep Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Neural network is a mathematical model constructed by imitating the nervous system of human brain, which is formed by complex connection of many artificial neurons. The loss back propagation algorithm promotes the self-learning of model parameters, and finally realizes the modeling of the complex relationship between pixels in the image. Similar to shallow learning algorithm, which only contains one or two layers of nonlinear transformation, deep learning has the ability to learn more advanced feature expression by simulating the principle and structure of human brain neurons and realizing multi-layer abstraction of features through multi-layer artificial neural network. In this article, a 3D image segmentation and recognition algorithm based on improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed, which reduces the dependence of traditional semantic segmentation model training on manually labeled data sets, improves the generalization ability of the network, and realizes the virtual reconstruction of 3D scenes by extracting the underlying features of 3D images. The comprehensive experimental results show that the image segmentation and recognition model based on the improved CNN algorithm has advantages over SVM algorithm in both accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Real-time measurement of dynamic pointing error of attitude stabilization platform based on photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: As a device for keeping the platform pointing in a specific direction, dynamic pointing error is a key index of a stabilized attitude platform. In this paper, a six-degree-offreedom platform is used to simulate changes in angle of the stabilized platform in working conditions so that the real-time pointing error in the platform during the motion can be calculated by analyzing the images captured by high-speed cameras installed on its worktable. The results reveal a strong link between the pointing error in the platform and the angle at which the platform strays off the original position almost irrelevant to the offset angle speed and acceleration. In addition, larger offset angle comes with greater pointing error. When the offset angle is 7.93<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>, the maximum value of the pointing error is 1.09<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>, which is slightly greater than its design index of 1°. This promotes the development and optimization of the attitude stabilization platform.

articleTitle: Research on Image Defogging Enhancement Technology Based on Retinex Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Under bad weather conditions, the quality of the image we get will be seriously affected. Therefore, we must restore and improve the image quality and enhance the image to meet the needs of human observation or subsequent processing. In recent years, an image enhancement technology based on Retinex algorithm has attracted wide attention because it is not affected by illumination and can better restore the original appearance of objects. In order to solve the problem that the details of the existing image enhancement algorithms are blurred when they are enhanced in foggy days, this paper will study the image defogging enhancement technology based on Retinex algorithm. The experimental results show that the clear processing method of foggy images in this paper has a good effect, but it needs a certain sample training time, and the higher the accuracy, the longer the time it takes, so it has certain algorithm complexity. From the subjective observation, this algorithm has better detail expression ability, eliminates the “halo artifact and at the same time, inhibits the over-sharpening phenomenon on the premise of ensuring hierarchy. Therefore, Retinex algorithm makes the defogging effect better under the condition of low complexity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of intelligent furniture Control System Based on Improved Particle Swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The functions of smart home products should be based on the needs of users. Only smart home products that can really solve the pain points of users can be recognized by the market. The emergence of all kinds of smart home devices began to form a new consumption frenzy. This paper studies the design and implementation of intelligent furniture control system based on improved PSO (Particle swarm optimization) algorithm. The topology of intelligent furniture control system is established. In order to improve the system performance, an improved PSO algorithm is proposed to optimize the PID controller parameters. Evolutionary speed factor and aggregation factor are introduced to improve the PSO algorithm. The improved PSO algorithm evaluates whether the particles are the best value by fitness value in the process of searching evolution. Simulation results show that the optimized parameters of improved PSO algorithm have the advantages of fast convergence speed, high convergence precision and strong anti-interference ability. The parameters of PID controller adjusted by improved PSO algorithm have better performance indexes in overshoot, steady-state error, adjustment time and so on.

articleTitle: A SBM-DDF-GML Algorithm for GTFP of Smart City Agglomeration Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The urban agglomeration in the Changjiang River Delta is one of the most important regional economic centers in mainland China and even the world. In this paper, the annual balance panel data of 27 cities in urban agglomeration in the Changjiang River Delta from 2010 to 2019 were collected, and the energy input and unexpected output were incorporated into the analysis framework of total factor productivity to construct the SBM-DDF model, and the efficiency value based on the SBM-DDF was calculated. From the static point of view, the overall GTFP of the Changjiang River Delta urban agglomeration presents a relatively stable trend. From the perspective of provinces, GTFP from high to low is ANHUI province, JIANGSU Province, SHANGHAI, ZHEJIANG Province; In terms of cities, HEFEI, ANQING, XUANCHENG, CHIZHOU, WENZHOU, CHUZHOU, YANCHENG and JINHUA have higher GTFP, while JIAXING, CHANGZHOU, HUZHOU and MA’ANSHAN have lower GTFP. From the dynamic point of view, when calculated by provinces in the Changjiang River Area, the average value of GML index of GTFP from high to low are SHANGHAI, JIANGSU, ZHEJIANG and ANHUI. Specifically, the GTFP of SHANGHAI, NANJING, NANTONG, WENZHOU, YANCHENG and ZHENJIANG is improving, while that of TAIZHOU, XUANCHENG, SUZHOU and TONGLING is declining. From the decomposition of GML index. Technological advances have deeply influenced changes in the GML index. The conclusion of this study has important policy implications for the Chinese modernization being promoted in mainland China.

articleTitle: Design of Image Recognition and Generation Algorithm Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Many traditional image recognition technologies are based on large-scale calculation, and there is an irreconcilable contradiction between the amount of calculation and the accuracy of calculation. In recent years, the development of ANN (artificial neural network) technology provides a new way to solve this problem. This paper focuses on the design of image recognition and generation algorithm based on ANN. This paper proposes an image recognition model based on BPNN (BP neural network), and introduces a multi attention mechanism into the language decoding model. By extracting image features at multiple levels and connecting image features at different levels to the multi-level language model through multi attention structure, the language decoding network can adaptively determine the weight of image features at each level used in generating description. The research results show that the improved BP algorithm is slightly better than the standard BP algorithm. It shows that neural network ensemble overcomes the instability of a single neural network and has better generalization ability. The multi-scale feature fusion model with increased attention mechanism generates more accurate image description statements than the model without increased attention mechanism, and the evaluation index is improved to some extent. At the same time, information such as the number and color of objects in the image can be obtained from details.

articleTitle: Design of a Group Animation Production System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the growth of communication technology and hardware technology, animation production can only meet the needs of the times by continuous innovation. Aiming at the problems of traditional animation, such as single method, heavy task and low autonomy, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is improved by using the convergence and divergence behavior in social learning mechanism. In order to improve the production method of group animation, this paper applies the modified PSO algorithm to the group animation production system driven by artificial intelligence, improves the influence mode of the “social” part of the standard PSO algorithm on particle motion, and selects the particle with the best fitness value in the particle field of view as the global extremum of the particle, so as to overcome the shortcoming that the original algorithm adopts the best individual among all particles as the global extremum and easily falls into the local optimum, thus simulating the group behavior more truly. The simulation results show that after the algorithm is iterated for a certain quantity of times, the particles tend to converge, but due to the limitation of the field of view, the quantity of connections between particles will remain in a relatively stable state, and the particles will not fall into the local optimum because of excessive aggregation, so it has the ability to continue exploration. PSO algorithm can truly simulate group behavior, which provides a basis for the design of group animation production system.

articleTitle: Simulation of Multi-Band Anti-Noise Broadcast Host Speech Recognition Method Based on Multi-Core Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Machine learning technology is widely used in computer vision, natural language processing, bioinformatics, medical image analysis, intrusion detection and many other fields. As the most important machine learning technology, the kernel method provides a powerful and unified learning framework. Based on the information fusion function and the application of radar emitter identification, two identification methods based on multi-core support vector machine (SVM) algorithm and algorithm framework are proposed respectively. Accounting can be understood as a linear algorithm in the feature space derived from the corresponding kernel function, which makes it relatively simple in concept. More importantly, the use of kernel function effectively improves the performance of many learning algorithms and greatly expands the applications of these algorithms in image segmentation, computer vision, target detection and other fields. Because the traditional speech recognition method is more accurate in quiet environment, but in real environment, noise interferes with speech feature extraction, resulting in unreliable measurement data and low accuracy of speech recognition method. A multi-band anti-noise speech recognition method based on multi-core learning is proposed, and a multi-core learning combination algorithm is constructed. According to different frequency bandwidths, multi-band noises can be effectively classified, and the speech feature level can be strengthened to jointly complete the multi-band anti-noise speech recognition method. The conditional probabilities of each model can be calculated, and the highest value is the speech recognition result.

articleTitle: Design of Dance Movement Recognition Algorithm Based on 3D Motion Capture Data
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Although the traditional photography, audio recording and video recording methods are easy to collect and make, they can't record the dancers' body movements in detail, let alone make scientific analysis and research on them and apply them to choreography. This paper proposes a dance movement Recognition technology based on 3D motion capture data. After fully considering the characteristics of dance movements, the HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradient) features extracted from dance videos are used to represent dance movements. In this paper, the image with HOG feature extraction has included the edge feature information of the target in all the images in the video segment after accumulation operation. The time series HMM (Hidden Markov model) is used to study the spatial information of adjacent joint points in the human skeleton model. Experiments show that the correct recognition rate of the proposed method can reach 97.797% when the number of nodes is 20. Experiments show that compared with one-dimensional Markov model method, the method proposed in this paper has better recognition effect and stronger anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Construction of Sampling System for Electric Power Materials Based on Convolution Neural Network Algorithm and Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the high demand of power supply security, the accuracy and timeliness of demand reporting of electric power emergency materials are getting higher and higher. If the intelligent image recognition technology can be used to identify the images uploaded from the accident scene, the problem of accurate demand reporting can be solved from the source, and the material supply can be guaranteed in time, which is of positive and important significance to improve the reliability of power supply. In this paper, the algorithm of visual recognition and image enhancement of power materials samples based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed, and then the construction of sampling system of power materials samples is realized. The results show that the CNN-based visual recognition model of power material sample image proposed in this paper can effectively solve the problem of unclear and not stereo images, while maintaining the clarity of power material sample images. With the help of this metal, a complete panoramic control system of electronic material intelligent detection can be established, which can prevent and control material risks and improve the efficiency and benefit of power grid material sampling quality detection.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Detection Algorithm Based on Computer Vision and Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the expansion of the installed capacity of power system and the scale of power grid, the operation of various electrical equipment requires the reliability of power system to be improved continuously. Transformer is one of the key equipments in the power distribution system, and its running state is directly related to the reliability of the whole power system. Condition-based maintenance technology is to diagnose the equipment by using maintenance technology when the equipment is charged. On-line detection and fault detection technology of transformer can improve the reliability of equipment, reduce the maintenance cost of equipment and improve economic benefits. In this paper, a transformer fault detection algorithm based on computer vision and deep learning technology is proposed, and the effectiveness and feasibility of transformer computer vision fault online detection technology are verified from two aspects: fault detection scheme design and transformer fault detection system. The simulation results show that with the increase of the number of experiments, the accuracy of this algorithm is stable at about 95%, and the real-time wavelength tends to be stable, which is 15.85% higher than the traditional algorithm on average. This method can effectively detect the transformer fault, and at the same time, it can detect the latent fault that leads to the drift of transformer winding parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Education Management Platform Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Excellent educational software is helpful to improve students’ learning interest and classroom teaching efficiency, which can not only impart knowledge, develop intelligence and cultivate ability, but also achieve the purpose of teaching students in accordance with their aptitude, entertaining and individualized teaching. Nowadays, science and technology are changing with each passing day, and new technologies are emerging one after another. With the continuous growth of social productive forces, the national income has been greatly improved, and the people’s living standard has reached a new level. At the same time, people’s thirst for knowledge is exploding. At present, the popular live broadcast courses, recording and broadcasting courses and online double-teacher courses in the Internet education industry have solved the problem of uneven distribution of educational resources to some extent. However, due to the lack of effective interaction between teachers and students, these educational methods still have the problems of low teaching efficiency and insufficient personalization. In order to increase the effective interaction between teachers and students, the company where the author practiced designed and developed an “offline” intelligent education platform based on interactive scenes. The platform established a perfect education scheme, and dynamically added interactive video clips on the basis of recorded and broadcast lessons, so that the teachers on the screen could interact with students in real time and efficiently while giving lectures, thus enhancing mutual understanding, enhancing students’ interest in learning on the basis of personalized teaching, and solving the problems of low human efficiency and insufficient personalization in the education industry.

articleTitle: Automatic Loading and Unloading Control System of Cable Materials Based on Artificial Immune Algorithm Remote Sensing Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Loading, unloading, transportation and transfer of materials is the key link connecting transportation, storage and distribution. It constantly appears and is repeated, including loading, unloading, transfer, classification, warehousing and warehousing. At present, the loading, unloading and transportation of many materials are still in the operation state of combining manpower, cart and forklift. The development of automatic control system for loading, unloading and transferring of cable materials can effectively improve the efficiency of loading, unloading and transferring of materials, reduce labor intensity and reduce costs. In this paper, the control strategy of automatic loading and unloading of materials based on artificial immune algorithm (AIA) remote sensing image recognition technology is proposed, which provides technical support for the construction of automatic loading and unloading control system of cable materials. The results show that, compared with the support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, the accuracy of AIA is improved by more than 20%. On this basis, the machine vision-based image recognition technology and binocular stereo vision recognition and positioning technology can be used to realize the identification and positioning of freight yard containers, and the bar code positioning technology and motor absolute encoder can be used to realize the motion positioning of each operating mechanism of container cranes.

articleTitle: Construction of Virtual Simulation System for Interior Design Based on Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: As one of the most intuitive technical means of design expression, VR (Virtual Reality) technology has become a platform for designers and customers to communicate and display. Compared with traditional design expression methods, the communication of design schemes is more efficient and can better meet customer requirements. This paper attempts to study interior design based on AR (Augmented Reality) and build a virtual simulation system. The simulation experiment proves that the success rate of the system established in this paper in the test of LED lamp modeling state is high, which can reach 81.85%. The average success rate of the traditional simulation system is only 47.3%. Similarly, compared with the traditional simulation system, the return rate of the system established in this paper is lower than that of the traditional system, and the average return rate in this paper is only 17.13%. Therefore, it can be concluded that the virtual simulation system of interior design established in this paper has more advantages in interior design. It can be seen that the application of AR technology in interior design has opened up a new interior design and display mode for us.

articleTitle: An Interactive Hybridization Algorithm for Optimization of Interior Layout Design
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Layout design is the content of interior decoration, but in the process of space layout, space utilization and product design will have an impact on visual satisfaction and reduce the effectiveness of layout design. Based on this, this paper proposes an interactive hybridization algorithm to analyze the layout design, improve the interior decoration level, and shorten the design scheme formulation time. Then, a comprehensive assessment of space utilization is performed. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to design the layout and output the final visual satisfaction. The results show that the interactive hybridization algorithm can improve the level of layout design, and the effectiveness is greater than 96% better than the layout of furnishing.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Image Detection System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the development of image recognition technology and computer technology, artificial intelligence is more and more applied in people’s production and life. In addition, the Internet of Things technology can be seen everywhere in our daily life. The purpose of this paper is to design an image detection system based on the Internet of Things technology, which uses CMOS image sensor to obtain real-time images, obtains candidate flame areas through flame judgment of image pixels, and uses flame detection method of in-depth study of neural network for flame detection. It communicates through the Internet of Things module and sends fire alarms and alarm messages to the server platform based on the flame detection results. The results show that the system designed in this paper meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Path-finding Algorithm for Sweeping Robot Based on BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Cleaning is a repetitive and time-consuming job. Although there are many kinds of vacuum cleaners that can make people get rid of the traditional cleaning tools, they still can’t get rid of the cleaning work, and these vacuum cleaners still have great limitations. With the continuous development and progress of technology, the general trend of artificial intelligence (AI) is coming. As a contemporary intelligent household appliance, sweeping robot has more and more applications. In this paper, the full coverage intelligent path-finding algorithm is designed and optimized, and an intelligent path-finding algorithm of sweeping robot based on improved Back-propagation neural network (BPNN) is proposed, so as to optimize the sweeping path of sweeping robot, select the best cleaning path and eliminate the cleaning blind area of sweeping robot as much as possible. Finally, the proposed algorithm and the traditional ACO algorithm are simulated and compared. The experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper can not only be well applied in closed unknown complex environment, but also has the advantages of few local sub-regions, short and smooth path, and also has good adaptability and real-time optimization characteristics.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of environmental intelligent monitoring system based on NB-IoT and cloud platform technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In this paper, a set of indoor temperature monitoring system is designed by using computer communication, database, sensor technology, etc., and the effective monitoring of temperature and humidity in the computer room is realized. The design is based on the arduino development board, the dht11 temperature and humidity sensor ESP8266WiFi module and the remote monitoring system. The temperature and humidity module is used to detect whether the temperature of the computer room exceeds the normal standard. If it exceeds the standard, the fan is automatically turned on to dissipate heat. The temperature and humidity are transmitted to the designated server through the wifi module, and are detected in real time through the monitoring system. The sensitivity of the temperature and humidity sensor can be flexibly adjusted according to the environment of the computer room. With the help of the Internet of Things sensor network and 5G network, the transmission is convenient, so as to solve some drawbacks in the current temperature monitoring. The user-friendly operating system interface provides managers with real-time, accurate and effective indoor environmental data, early warning and self-processing functions, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the computer room.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet Innovation and Entrepreneurship Information Service System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: At present, mass entrepreneurship and innovation are becoming the new engines of China’s economic growth. Building an innovative country requires a large number of innovative and entrepreneurial talents, and college students have the obligation and responsibility to become the main force of innovation and entrepreneurship (IAE). Providing IAE training for students can help improve the comprehensive quality and competitiveness of college students. However, at present, the proportion of college students participating in entrepreneurship is low, and the awareness of IAE is generally lacking. Therefore, colleges and universities need to further promote IAE education and strengthen the construction of entrepreneurship training system. In this Internet age, to make IAE education more effective, we must rely on the power of the Internet. This paper aims to study the design and implementation of the Internet IAE information service system based on data mining. This paper deeply studies the application background and current situation of data mining technology at home and abroad, and analyzes the model system of data mining technology applied in Internet IAE. The system implements a responsive layout to ensure that the website can also have a better display effect on the mobile terminal. The basic function of the system is to provide IAE training. The system modules include IAE project management, IAE information management, quality assessment and selection of IAE mentors. The system should provide business needs and business information to businesses and students. The system does this using a text-based algorithm based on word vectors. After the system converts the text to a vector, it uses Kmeans to group the text. Next, recommend the text with the highest similarity to the user. Experiments show that the information retrieval and mining speed of the system constructed in this paper is more than 10 times faster than the traditional algorithm. In the case of multiple people logging in in parallel, the average response time of the system constructed in this paper is also below 0.3s.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Simulation Analysis Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Mathematical modeling is a bridge course that combines mathematics with technology and society. Its main purpose is to help people solve problems that cannot be solved in daily life, that is, to solve complex things in life by establishing models. With the progress of science and technology, there are more and more technical means of mathematical modeling application. Based on this, combined with the development of modeling technology, the optimization application of AI(artificial intelligence) algorithm in mathematical modeling is discussed. The author organically combines AI algorithm to carry out mathematical modeling and realize the optimal route planning model. The AI algorithm is optimized and a new mathematical modeling solution method is designed. Firstly, describe the navigation route and constraint conditions of the ship; Secondly, according to the constraint conditions, the planning mathematical model is constructed; Finally, the solution function is designed based on AI algorithm, and the solution of the mathematical modeling is obtained. The research results show that the route length of this design method is 135.6, and the route planning length of the comparison algorithm is more than 200. It can be seen that the route planning effect of this design method is good. The method designed in this paper has a high ability to save the operating cost of the route, and the application effect of the algorithm designed in this paper is better than that in use at present.

articleTitle: Study on Data Security of Computerization under Centralized Accounting Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: After the comprehensive implementation of the financial centralized accounting, the expenditure behavior of administrative institutions has been controlled to a great extent, and the financial accounting, financial management and supervision have been strengthened. From the root of the control of financial funds to be strengthened, so as to ensure that the income and expenditure of administrative institutions are legal and compliant. However, after the implementation of financial computerization, there are many data security problems in financial information. The main measures to solve this problem are strictly control the login authority; strengthen the security and confidentiality of computerized financial files.

articleTitle: Research on Node classification Algorithm based on Deep Network representation learning under incomplete information
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Most of the existing network representation learning models are designed under the assumption that the network is complete. In practice, large-scale networks often have incomplete/missing node content or links. Therefore, its performance will be affected by missing nodes. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a node classification algorithm DNRL based on deep network representation learning under incomplete information. Firstly, transfer probability matrix is used to integrate structural information and attribute information dynamically, which makes up for the excessive loss caused by incomplete structural information. Then, a depth generation model (variational autoencoder) with powerful feature extraction ability is used to learn the lowdimensional representation of nodes through the joint optimization of graph attention network and autoencoder. At the same time, the potential high nonlinear features of network data are captured from three perspectives: node attributes, local structure and global structure. Finally, through evaluation and analysis, the proposed algorithm has better node classification effect.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Risk Control Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Traditional credit risk control is mostly model-driven strategy, which has been unable to meet the demand of default risk prediction, resulting in frequent default events, which bring great losses to institutions. Therefore, it is necessary to introduce machine learning algorithm to improve the credit risk control mechanism and promote the healthy and sustainable development of the credit business market. In the early stage of new credit products, there is no business accumulation, only a small amount of labeled data and a large amount of unlabeled data, so it is not possible to establish a data-driven supervised credit risk control model. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a financial risk control model based on semi-supervised learning. A dual-model cooperative training method was used to construct high quality pseudo tags. Unlabeled data was used as the communication medium between the models. Finally, experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of semi-supervised learning in the financial risk control scenario.

articleTitle: Design of multi-objective optimal control algorithm for automatic driving of EMU based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization in China, the scale of cities is getting bigger and bigger, and the population of cities is increasing. The existing urban transportation network has been unable to meet the requirements of urban development. The application of automatic driving system ATO in urban rail trains can effectively ensure the safety and comfort of train operation, and it has more outstanding advantages than manual driving in automatically adjusting train speed, accurately stopping at stations on time and reducing energy consumption. Because of the complexity of the train running process, its running speed is usually affected by line conditions, speed limit conditions and driver proficiency, so there are many uncertain factors. The use of auto drive system instead of train driver driving can meet the requirements of various performance indicators during train operation, while avoiding arbitrary factors caused by human. Therefore, it is necessary to study auto drive system. Applying this algorithm to the optimization design of a large number of feature points, good linearization design results have been obtained, and the simulation results have been verified, which can also meet the simulation requirements. The simulation results show that the algorithm is effective and superior for control parameter optimization, and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Optical Fiber Communication Technology in Network Remote Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the design phase of the network remote control system, due to the lack of sorting of communication data, the performance of the control system is difficult to stabilize at a higher level. Aiming at this, the design and development of optical fiber communication technology in the network remote control system are proposed. The MYC-J335X-V2 core board is used as the development hardware of the design system, and a network remote control system with a three-layer structure including the use layer, storage layer and service layer is designed. Optical fiber communication technology is used as the basis for data interaction at all levels. Industrial DH/DH+ fieldbus optical fiber repeater RT-FHI-S is used as the optical fiber repeater of the system, and the layer to point communication structure is established; The storage layer sets fuzzy rules for the signals in the optical fiber repeater to solve the problem that the optical fiber repeater cannot completely match the network membership function; In the service layer, the data transmitted by the optical fiber repeater is statically and uniformly quantified, so as to reduce the response time of the system. In the test results, the design system achieves stable high performance output in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on a Prediction Model and Importance Algorithm Based on KPCA LightGBM Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper aims to propose a joint prediction model and factor contribution analysis algorithm based on KPCA-LightGBM. Firstly, kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) is used to reduce the dimension of nonlinear data. Secondly, light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) is used for data regression and prediction. Finally, MSE and $R^{2}$ were used as model accuracy tests on the predictions of the 31 time series data. The research results show that KPCA can better grasp the characteristics of nonlinear data, such as this paper simplifies 20-dimensional data to 5-dimensional, which can reflect the original data up to more than 95%, and the prediction accuracy of the joint KPCA-LightGBM model is higher compared with the traditional machine learning model, up to 94%.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Waterscape based on CiteSpace and Information Visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to fully grasp the research history and development status of waterscape in China, and to promote the research and design practice of watescape, the following paper uses CNKI database to search literatures on related topics, and makes a visual analysis of the selected literatures through visualization analysis software (CiteSpace). The results show that: (1) The development of waterscape research can be divided into three stages: preliminary exploration, rapid development and slow development; (2) There are many and scattered researchers in the field of waterscape in China. The researches are lack of depth and sustainability, and the core group of researchers with sufficient scale has not been formed; (3) Four hot research directions in the field of water landscape: waterscape design, water ecology, water culture, and storm water management; (4) The focus of waterscape research is gradually shifting to sustainable development, environment, water ecology and garden landscape.

articleTitle: Research on PCA-Kmeans++ clustering algorithm considering Spatiotemporal dimension
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional clustering algorithms cannot adapt to spatiotemporal data mining, this paper proposes a new clustering algorithm PCA-Kmeans++. First, in order to reduce the interference of data dimension, an improved PCA (principal component analysis) dimensionality reduction algorithm is built. On this basis, a K-means++algorithm considering space-time dimension is proposed to cluster the reduced factors. Finally, 100000 AFC data are collected for validity verification. The results show that: (1) The improved PCA algorithm has better dimensionality reduction effect. (2) The spatiotemporal clustering algorithm based on K-means++can effectively enhance the efficiency of classification decision-making. This study provides relevant basis and methodology for proposing a generic clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-algorithm Fusion Based on AHP-GCA-MPC Power Division Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to propose an effective power allocation algorithm, this paper aims to propose a power allocation fusion method with strong generality, which is composed of three versions of AHP-GCA-MPC, and its purpose is to optimize the power allocation. Finally, by bringing in x sets of data to test the model, the results show that: (1) the power allocation optimization model proposed in this paper can effectively end the power allocation; (2) the algorithm in this paper provides a methodology and decision base for power allocation.

articleTitle: Research on Forest Landscape based on Big data and CiteSpace Visualization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to fully grasp the development and research status of forest landscape ecology, this paper analyzed the literatures related to forest landscape from 1982 to 2020 on CNKI and Wanfang Data Service platform. Based on Python language environment, this paper uses Scrapy framework to extract literature data, and uses CiteSpace visual analysis software to draw knowledge map. It analyzes and visualizes the amount of articles published, research groups, research hotspots and trends. The results showed that: (1) the development process of forest landscape ecology research was divided into three stages: initial exploration period from 1982 to 2002, rapid development period from 2003 to 2008, and stable development period from 2009 to present. (2) The number of scholars in this field is relatively large and scattered, and the influential core author group and institutional group has not yet been formed; (3) The hot research directions are forest landscape pattern, sustainable development of forest, and forest landscape planning and design. (4) The focus of forest landscape ecology research has gradually shifted from geographic information system to eco-tourism, urban forest and planning and design, and the research has become specialized and meticulous.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Virtual Machine Scheduling Strategies and Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Cloud computing is widely used in the engineering field with the advantage of low cost and high service. The data center, as the carrier of cloud applications, consumes a lot of power and wastes more and more resources in providing services to the cloud. In this paper, a new VM migration strategy is proposed to address the problem that existing research cannot effectively balance the quality of service and energy consumption. The strategy uses a combination of algorithms for load prediction, selection and placement of VMs to optimize the VM migration process at all stages simultaneously. The specific work includes the following aspects.(1)The load prediction phase uses a combination of BP neural network, differential autoregressive moving average model (ARIMA), and least squares support vector machine model (LSSVM) prediction methods to identify overloaded and underutilized hosts in the data center.(2)The virtual machine selection algorithm (HULT) based on high CPU utilization and low migration time is proposed in the virtual machine selection phase to migrate virtual machines from overloaded hosts and lightly loaded hosts.(3)The virtual machine placement phase proposes the Resource Utilization Based Best Adaptation Decreasing Virtual Machine Placement algorithm (RU-PABFD), the virtual machine placement process is based on the original Best Adaptation Decreasing algorithm, and the original algorithm is improved by adding the constraint of the remaining resource utilization of the destination host. And the combined prediction algorithm, HULT algorithm and RU-PABFD algorithm are combined to obtain the complete virtual machine scheduling policy (VMS-CP).The algorithm proposed in this paper can guarantee the quality of service and reduce the waste of resources in the data center, while maintaining the balance between energy consumption and performance.

articleTitle: Research on Medical Big Data Mining and Intelligent Analysis for Smart Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the process of rapid socio-economic development, people’s living standards have been improved to varying degrees. At the same time, more and more people are turning their attention to physical health while satisfying their material and spiritual lives. In order to provide more effective health protection, China has established a medical system covering the whole country. While increasing medical investment, China has improved its medical level through the integration of high-tech, including the application of big data technology in smart healthcare. This article first introduces the basic framework of intelligent analysis and cloud computing, and then applies medical big data mining and formulas to the field of smart healthcare, which can adjust smart healthcare by calculating the average and standard deviation of medical care. Finally, practical analysis is conducted on big data mining in smart healthcare, and it is analyzed that it is in line with smart healthcare big data mining. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the level of medical big data preprocessing, and the data mining effect is good. Finally, this article explains the new technologies such as medical IoT, cloud computing, big data mining, and intelligent analysis in the definition of smart healthcare, as well as analyzes the basic concepts and business forms to prove the effectiveness of smart healthcare. Among them, this article obtains relevant health data from various sensors of patients, achieving 78% recognition, 87% detection, and 92% control of the tested object from Data 1 to Data 4. Therefore, combining big data mining with intelligent algorithms in smart healthcare can greatly improve assistance.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Platform Computing Security and Integrity Protection System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Cloud computing has gained widespread popularity in various fields due to its benefits, including on-demand resource provisioning, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. However, the rapid expansion of cloud computing services has raised significant concerns about the security and integrity of cloud data. This paper proposes a security and integrity protection system for cloud computing based on machine learning algorithms. The proposed system employs various machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and Naive Bayes, to detect and prevent security threats in cloud computing. Additionally, the proposed system employs encryption techniques to ensure data confidentiality in the cloud. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system can effectively detect and prevent security threats, thus preserving the integrity of cloud data.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Mode of Experiential Learning Environment Based on VR Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The VR computer simulation technology, computer graphics technology, multimedia technology, sensing technology, network technology and other high-tech technologies are integrated to realize a three-dimensional virtual environment similar to the real life environment, such as sight, hearing and touch. This paper attempts to build an experiential learning environment teaching mode based on VR virtual simulation technology. Edit with the help of other editing software, and import the edited material into Unity3D for presentation. By entering the virtual practice system of related disciplines, students can practice in different positions in free time and space, and understand the business contacts between different departments. The results show that virtual experimental courseware is helpful to express the teaching information of the subject, promote learners’ mastery of relevant knowledge, satisfy their desire for knowledge, and better help them to construct the meaning of what they have learned.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Information Security Protection System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of high technology and economy, our country has entered a new era of artificial intelligence in the 21st century. Home appliances of artificial intelligence, auxiliary software of artificial intelligence, learning tools of artificial intelligence, etc., have gradually become an inseparable part of national life, so the flourishing development of information technology and network makes people’s life more convenient and efficient, but at the same time, because we are in the new era of artificial intelligence, these applications in different fields not only help to improve the efficiency of work in various fields, but also give The computer network information security protection technology brings challenges, so information technology and network also has two sides, which computer network information security problems to the country and people bring certain impact and trouble, so this paper discusses and discusses the computer network information security problems in the era of artificial intelligence, and puts forward the corresponding protection countermeasures.
